Assertion (A): Renunciation of Indian citizenship by a parent causes their minor children to automatically lose Indian citizenship.
Reason (R): Under Section 8(2) of the Citizenship Act 1955, minor children derive their citizenship status through their parents, but may resume citizenship within 1 year of attaining full age.

question.en:
Assertion (A): Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) status cannot be equated with full constitutional Indian citizenship.
Reason (R): OCI cardholders are foreign nationals registered under Section 7A who do not possess voting rights or eligibility for constitutional public offices.
